target.title: feat: add bridge rich links
target.body:
## Summary
- add `send-rich --url <url> --rich-link` for bridge-backed URL preview balloon sends
- forward RPC `send.rich` params `url` + `rich_link: true` into the bridge
- generalize helper balloon-message construction and archive `LPLinkMetadata` for `com.apple.messages.URLBalloonProvider` payloads
- fix queued CLI/RPC identity resolution so URL-only rich-link sends resolve using the effective URL text
- remove the release-owned changelog edit; release-note context stays in this PR body

## Redacted runtime proof on lobster
Proof collected on lobster with branch-local artifacts from `feat/rich-links` and a freshly relaunched SIP-disabled injected Messages.app session. Raw logs stay local because they include chat GUIDs, message GUIDs, row IDs, and local identifiers.

- branch head after review/CI fixes: `fdd7484`
- runtime proof directory: `/Users/lobster/imsg-pr-proofs/2026-07-08/165-rich-links/bridge-run-20260708-213156`
- visual proof: `/Users/lobster/imsg-pr-proofs/2026-07-08/165-rich-links/bridge-run-20260708-213156/visual/messages-rich-link-proof.png`
- source screenshot supplied by user: `/Users/lobster/GitHub/imsg/.orca/drops/Snapzy_2026-07-08_21-32-19_007.png`
- test chat: `Lobster Test Group` (chat row 22; GUID redacted in PR text)
- status proof: `imsg status --json` reported SIP disabled, bridge v2 ready, and `send.rich` available
- before/scope: existing `main` did not expose `--url ... --rich-link` rich URL preview sends
- code-fix proof: queued CLI and RPC URL-only rich-link tests now assert `MessageSendOptions.text == "https://imsg.sh"` so sent-message lookup uses the URL instead of empty text
- plain bridge URL run: `send-rich --text https://imsg.sh --json` exited 0 and returned queued row/guid fields
- rich-link run: `send-rich --url https://imsg.sh --rich-link --json` exited 0 and returned queued row/guid fields, including resolved `guid`, `message_id`, `messageGuid`, and row `id`
- history readback: rows immediately after the marker contain the plain URL and rich-link URL sends with distinct message GUIDs
- visual confirmation: Messages.app showed the marker `PR165 bridge proof 20260708-213156` followed by two rendered `imsg.sh` URL preview cards; the second card corresponds to the rich-link command

Note: a first attempt to use the standard AppleScript `imsg send` path for the plain URL comparison timed out in Messages.app (`AppleEvent timed out`). The completed proof therefore compares bridge plain URL text send vs bridge `--rich-link` URL send in the same chat/session.

## Verification
- `make build` ✅ on lobster for `fdd7484`
- `swift format lint --recursive Sources Tests TestsLinux` ✅
- `git diff --check` ✅
- `make lint` ⚠️ blocked after swift-format by local SwiftLint/SourceKit crash: `Loading sourcekitdInProc.framework/Versions/A/sourcekitdInProc failed`
- `make test` ⚠️ blocked before project tests run on this host: `Tests/IMsgCoreTests/BridgeHelperLocatorTests.swift:2:8: error: no such module 'Testing'`
- GitHub CI ✅ for `fdd7484`; previous head `b9d014a` had a macOS test compile failure from a helper-test dependency, now made self-contained




## Supplemental proof caveat
After the original proof was posted, additional sender-side and recipient-side screenshots showed an important difference that the initial recipient-only proof did not capture:

- bridge plain URL sends rendered as ordinary blue URL text on the sender side
- the bridge `--url ... --rich-link` send rendered as a URL preview-style balloon, but earlier recipient-side captures showed `Click to Load Preview` placeholder cards rather than the fully resolved Messages compose preview
- a separate Messages compose/generated preview can render a richer `Messages.app from your terminal` card for the same `https://imsg.sh` URL

Local supplemental screenshots:
- sender-side comparison: `/var/folders/ks/54l0_v5j441gbf_8nbz9kgb80000gn/T/orca-paste-1783572815782-e8fffa2f-9a83-4965-84ad-2d91ac1b3b79.png`
- recipient-side follow-up: `/Users/lobster/GitHub/imsg/.orca/drops/Snapzy_2026-07-08_21-53-55_150.png`

So the current proof should be read narrowly: it demonstrates that the bridge path can send a URL-preview balloon, but it does **not** yet prove parity with the richer preview generated by Messages.app's normal compose pipeline. This likely needs either a payload improvement or a product decision to document the bridge behavior as preview-placeholder/metadata-limited.
